definition: The ancestors two styles both reach up their cascades, families among them. Where both inherit a slot from one of these, the two agree on it without either having bound it.
basis: docs/inheritance.md: "A child style inherits its parent's bindings and overrides selectively." mcp_server/core.py compares two styles by the ancestors their cascades hold in common: "shared = set(_cascade(a)) & set(_cascade(b))".
